tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal bar byed pa'i bsnyen pa'i man ngag bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dang ye shes mgon po gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po bdud kyi rgyal mtshan kun snyol zhing*// dkar po chos kyi ba dan skyong ba'i gnyen// bstan srung bya rog ming can 'di 'dra'i rdzi// bstan pa'i bar snang gar yang gzhan ma langs// de ltar shes nas phyag byas de bsnyen thabs// gang gi lag son mod la gang legs pa// char rgyas dbyar ka'i yid 'ong mtsho dag dang*// gong du 'phel la 'gran pas dga' ba skyes// de yang 'o skol gyi ston pa'i bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs chen po'i bsnyen pa'i man ngag bshad par bya ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i mthar bgegs la gtor ma byin nas bskrad la/ dkyil 'khor rten rdzas rnams sbyang ba'i phyir/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i dbyings su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ bh+rūṃ las ri mtsho gling rnams kyis bskor ba'i ri rab kyi rtser/ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ge sar la ha las sna tshogs rdo rje gdong bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐/ de gsum gyi 'od zer gcig tu 'dres pa 'phros pas/ 'og dang steng logs phyir rim pa bzhin rdo rje'i sa gzhi gur bla bre ra ba dang drwa ba/ bar chad kyi bdud thams cad kyis mi phyed pa/ de'i phyi rol du ral gri 'khor lo mda' phur bu gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rdo rje rtse mo gcig pa dang gsum pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa sogs mtshon cha sna tshogs pa dang*/ me kha dog lngas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su oṃ dkar po rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin zhu ba las dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor rtsig pa rdo rje rin po che dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba las grub pa gru bzhi pa rmang gi phyir pad+ma rā ga'i snam bu/

kha khyer la gser gyi pha gu/ mun par gser gdung las mu tig gi drwa ba drwa phyed/ bya 'dabs las thur du ba ku lā'i steng du mda' yab dkar po/ bar bar du gdugs dang 'phan rgyal mtshan gyis brgyan pa/ khang pa brtsegs pa dbus 'phyur bu yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i tog byas pa/ sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng gi pad+ma la gser gyi 'khor lo gdugs kyis phub pa la ri dwags zung lta ba/ phyi kun tu bzang po'i rgyan bkod pa'i gzhal med kyi khang chen po ji lta ba/ nang zhag gi rgya mtsho/ de'i nang du tshud cing phyed kyi tshad dbyibs de lta bu'i gsung gi dkyil 'khor rtsig pa nor bu dkar dmar sngo ba/ nang khrag gi rgya mtsho/ de'i nang du tshud cing phyed kyi tshad thugs kyi dkyil 'khor thod pa skam rnyid rlon gsum gnam lcags kyi zhun dang khrag zhag gi 'dam gyis brtsegs pa dur khrod kyi khang pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba/ nang klad pa'i rgya mtsho/ de'i nang du bde chen gyi 'khor lo ral gri'i phreng bas gru bzhi gling dgur bcad pa'i lte bar/ gri gug dang rdo rjes zlum por bskor ba'i phyi ma drag po e/ nang ma pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ 'khor gnas thams cad du hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba re/ dbus kyi hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po chen po bya rog gi ming can/ bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs la drag shul chen por khros pa/ za byed srin po'i gzugs/ mthing nag sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba rno dkar gangs ri 'dra ba gtsigs pa'i bar nas srid pa bshol ba'i chu 'brub pa/ ljags glog ltar rnam par 'gyur ba/ ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ la sogs pa'i nga ro 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba lta bur bsgrag pas khams gsum gyi dbang po thams cad myos su 'jug pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas 'thor byed kyi rlung 'tshubs pas ma rungs pa thams cad brlag par byed pa/

gdug pa can thams cad gzir ba'i spyan gsum nyi ma 'bum bzhin 'bar la sma ra ag tshoms smin ma'i me 'khyog por 'khyil ba/ bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis bai ta'i 'bras bu snying 'dra ba dang*/ lha ma yin gyi thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs ka'i steng 'og tu bzung nas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis ro langs kyi lce las grub pa'i ral gri 'bar ba dang dbang phyug gi rtse gsum dar dpyangs ḍā ma ru dang ldan pa 'phyar ba/ rū tra btul ba'i rus pa'i rgyan drug /thod pa dang rin po che'i cod pan/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ 'og pag phud kyi sgra dang dug gi rlangs pa mi zad pa 'byin pa'i klu brgyad/ rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi sor ris/ khrag sbar 'dzag pa'i mgo bo lnga bcu rgyu mar brgyus pa'i do shal rnams kyis spras pa/ skra mtshams su sprul pa'i khyung nag /spyi gtsug tu dpal ldan lhan cig skyes pa dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu gnas pa/ glang po che sa srung gi pags pa dang dar dpyangs kyis stod g.yogs pa/ ma traṃ dang stag mi zan stong gi zhing sham thabs su mdzad de/ sku'i ba spu'i khung nas spros pa'i bskal pa sreg pa'i me mi bzad pa'i du ba 'khrug pa'i dbus na rgyal po chen po'i rol pas/ rdo rje'i thog mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i 'khyug khro bo 'chol ba'i ser ba 'bebs bzhin du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan bsgral ba'i baṃ chen po brdzis te bzhugs pa'i pang du/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka sku mdog nag mo khro ba'i zhal/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ phyag g.yas gshin rje'i lce 'dra ba'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon mu stegs bsgral ba'i thod pa khrag gis gang ba yab la stob pa/ dbu skra ser po thur du grol ba/ gcer bu thod pa dang sbrul dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing yab dang rdo rje pad+ma gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa/ g.yas su dbyings yum e ka dzā ṭi khro mo mche gcig spyan gcig ma/

g.yas zhing dbyug dang g.yon snying dang lcags spyang khra thabs su 'gyed pa/ 'ja' tshon gyi ber gyon te ral pa rting par drud nas g.yas brkyang gis ro'i khar bzhugs pa/ g.yon du sgrol yum 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug dud pa'i sol ba ma nag mo skem zhing sbeg la shin tu gtum pa zhal gdangs nas mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa'i bar du mi ro gsol ba/ spyan gsum ldog nas gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri dang bhāñja/ g.yon shāk+ti dang tri shū la/ ma mo'i chas brgyad kyis spras te bong bu gwa dmar gyi steng na tsan 'khyil gyis bzhugs pa/ shar gyi 'dab mar 'phrog ma dkar mo/ lhor glang sna ma ser mo/ nub tu srin mo ral pa can dmar mo/ byang du myos byed sa'i gtsug ljang kha/ zhal gcig shin tu khros pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po rnams su lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu/ 'og ma rnams ral gri/ g.yon thams cad la thod khrag dang rtse gsum/ ye shes kyi ma re ti mched bzhi ka'ang gcer bu thod pa dang sbrul dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan te g.yas brkyang gis ro'i khar bzhugs pa/ mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ chos 'byung gi gru mdun nas g.yas skor du/ hūm̐ mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa srin po'i gzugs can rang gi sha la za ba tsam du gtum pa/ gad rgyangs dang bcas pa'i so dang mchu las khrag 'dzag cing spyan gsum dmar po/ dbu skra ser po thod phreng gis bcings shing phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bzung ba/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang gis ro'i khar brjid par bzhugs pa/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po nag po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ g.yas gsum gri gug thod phreng ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gsum thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i bzhin ras can/ dpral bar sin dhu ras byugs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan te gyad kyi dor stabs su log 'dren glang po che'i gdong pa can brdzi ba/

gsang ba ye shes kyi mgon po nag po gdong bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal steng ma gnyis nag po/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis ral gri dang rus phreng 'phyar ba/ spyan bcu gnyis me ltar 'bar ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang ba/ tshangs skud dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan te g.yas brkyang gis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ zla gam gsum la de dag gi yum mkha' 'gro nag mo/ zhi byed dkar mo/ srung byed ser mo ste ye shes kyi ma gsum/ gru bzhir dpal las kyi mgon po dang*/ yum tsaṇ+ḍi ka dmar mo 'bar ba'i gdong*/ sku'i sprul pa tshe bdag dang sha za ma/ gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag dang khrag 'thung ma/ thugs kyi sprul pa 'chi bdag dang rtsa 'jib ma ste las kyi ma gsum/ yab rnams thung la gel bas mi'u thung lta bu/ khro bo'i bzhin la bya rog gi mchu/ rngam zhing rkan sgra tog pas srid pa gsum ldeg pa/ g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sku las gdug pa'i me phung 'phro zhing dur khrod kyi chas thams cad 'chang ba/ khros pa'i zhabs brdabs pas sa gzhi g.yo zhing bdud kyi sde thams cad brlag par byed pa/ rdo rje'i gshog pa brgyangs pas drag po'i las la rgod pa/ ma mo bdun ka'ang shin tu gtum zhing sbeg pa/ ral gri dang thod khrag can ma mo'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan te rol pa'i stabs kyis ro'i khar bzhugs pa/ ling rtser sku'i mgon po stag zhon nag po phyag g.yas tsan+dan gyi beng dgra bo'i klad du gsor zhing*/ g.yon nyams pa'i ske nas btags te khrid pa'i zhags pa dang bcas pas par bu khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ klad du bya khra gzhung ba/ rol du seṅge dom dred ce spyang khrid cing gtum mo nag mo khram baṃ dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi mgon po beng dmar smug

phyag g.yas dmag gi gter tsan+dan gyi beng bsgreng ba/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i phur pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kun tu dgyes ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ yon tan gyi mgon po legs ldan mthing nag phyag gnyis thugs kar gri gug gis thod khrag dkrug cing*/ tsan+dan gyi beng mchan g.yas su gzer ba/ dbu la khyung lding ba/ sta zur la seṅge 'khrab pa/ rtsib logs la 'phar dred 'khyug pa/ zhabs la stag 'phro ba/ nad mtshon gyi bskal pa dgra la 'gyed cing*/ kro dhi shwa ri sngo skya sbrul zhags dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ rbod gtong gi mgon po ma ning nag po/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ ru mtshon can 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon zhags pa dang snying 'dzin pa u ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ gsung gi mgon po tshogs bdag chen po a gho ra mthing nag phyag g.yas tsan+dan gyi beng 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bzung nas/ zlog byed ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ de thams cad kyang mi bzad pa'i khro bo shin tu 'jigs pa'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gyen thur thad kar gzigs pa/ sma ra ag tshoms smin ma mer 'bar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa la rin po che'i par khab dang thod skam lngas brgyan cing*/ mgo dang snying sbrel ba rgyu ma'i thag pas brgyus pa dang sbrul sbram ga shar byas pa za 'og gi ber sum brtsegs snrel zhir gyon nas gser gwa phra mang mgul la bcings pa/ sag ri'i lahwam po che gsol nas g.yon brkyang gis dgra bo bsgral ba'i bam la bzhugs pa/ thugs kyi mgon po rdo rje nag po 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin zhing*/ dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa la mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/

rlon pa lnga cu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi sham thabs can/ mi'u thung gel ba'i stangs stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ g.yas su bya nag g.yon du khyi nag rgyab na ce spyang*/ mdun na mi nag steng na pho nya 'gyed pa/ tsā muṇ+ḍi nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ phrin las kyi mgon po nag po gri gug zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ bdud kyi ber nag po gsol zhing*/ spyan gsum me phung ltar dmar ba/ khro gnyer bsdus shing smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser 'khyug la me ltar 'bar ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba zla tshes lta bu/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa la rin po che dang thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i skra lan bur lhas pa gcig la gcig brgyus pas do shal byas pa/ gsus khyim che zhing sku sha rgyas pa/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i cha byad can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas mi ro mnan nas nga ro pheṃ skad du sgrog pa/ dpa' mo nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i mgon po trag shad nag po chibs su bra nag rting dkar la chibs pa/ sku la bdud kyi ber nag gsol zhing sked la gser gwa dang rin po che bcings pa/ stag ral g.yas dang gzig shubs g.yon du btags pa/ phyag g.yas mdung dar nag po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dgra snying srog rtsa gsum dang ma bral bar khyer ba/ bdud zhabs nag po mthe'u chung gis bzung zhing gzhu gru mo la bkal ba/ mda' bya rgod ma dang bdud kyi khram shing sked la btsugs pa/ ral pa kham nag zhu lugs su byas pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing 'khrug pa/ zhal am gtsigs bsdams pa/ sring mo dung skyong sna tshogs gdong mas rta mthur nas khrid pa/ sgo mtshams brgyad la bya rgod gdong ma dang*/ phag gdong ma dang*/ 'ug gdong ma dang*/ khyi gdong ma dang*/ khwa gdong ma dang*/

spyang gdong ma dang*/ khyung gdong ma dang*/ stag gdong ma thams cad kyang gcer bu mthing nag phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing gri thod bzung nas ro'i steng du gar gyis rol pa/ nang thams cad 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa/ gzhan yang dpal gyi mgon po/ ye shes kyi ma/ las byed kyi khro bo'i rigs thams cad tshogs pa/ mthong na skyi zing ba/ gsung dkyil gyi grwa nang ma'i shar gyi g.yas nas rim pa bzhin/ tsartsi ka drag pos 'khyud pa la/ rgan byed ma dang*/ drag mo dang*/ 'jigs ma dang*/ u mas bskor ba/ khyab 'jug ma rtsigs pa can gyis 'khyud pa la/ 'phrog byed ma dang*/ 'bar byed ma dang*/ 'jigs byed ma dang*/ yul 'khor skyong ma/ phag mo drag po chen pos 'khyud pa la/ rgyal ma dang*/ rnam par rgyal ma dang*/ mi thub ma dang*/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ gzhon nu ma mi sdug pas 'khyud pa la/ 'jigs byed ma dang*/ gzugs can ma dang*/ mche gtsigs ma dang*/ thod pa can ma/ drag mo lhas byin gyis 'khyud pa la/ nag mo chen mo dang*/ nag sbom dang*/ bzang mo dang*/ mche ba can ma/ dpa' mo dga' bar ldan pas 'khyud pa la/ thod 'phreng 'dzin ma dang*/ 'phreng 'dzin ma dang*/ tri shū la 'dzin ma dang*/ sbrul 'dzin ma/ dbang mo nag mo khyab byed kyis 'khyud pa la/ dbang mo dang*/ zla ba mo dang*/ drag tu sdang ba mo dang*/ rna ba 'phyang ma/ tshangs ma log sred can gyis 'khyud pa la/ ral gri ma dang*/ dgra s+t+wa ma dang*/ mda' thogs ma dang*/ gzhu can mas bskor ba/ yab yum rnams mthing nag zhal gcig mi bzad par khros pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa/ lhag ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang tri shū la/ dur khrod kyi chas can ro'i gdan la 'gying ba/ 'khor gyi ma mo rnams mdun nas g.yas bskor gyis nag ser dmar ljang ba gri thod can gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan te gar mdzad pa/ lha khyams phyi mar zhing skyong zhi ba'i gdong ma dang dril bu chen po/ dpal chen mo dang me'i gdong*/

bde byed ma dang gyen du 'bar skra/ sna mo che dang mchog gi dbang phyug me 'bar ma dang sgra chen/ me lce'i kha ma dang dril bu'i sgra/ dmar ser ma dang byin/ bong zhon ma dang glang chen rna ba/ ba lang rna ma dang bu gu'i byin can/ rim pa mo dang rtsig pa/ mthong gshol ma dang spu'i byin pa/ tsā muṇ+ḍi dang bum pa/ bzhin mdangs ma dang ral pa gsum pa/ glog gi gdong ma dang dril bu'i sgra chen/ me lce'i gdong ma dang bya ba kun mdzes/ ka rañja gnas ma dang dril chen/ lha mo chen mo dang sgra chen po/ gtum mo dang bskyed pa/ skye bo ma dang lhun po chen po/ 'dod ma dang 'jigs pa/ a mra ko dang brtul zhugs chen po/ dzi li'i sgra 'byin ma dang sna chen/ lhan cig skyes ma dang thub dka'/ dbang bskur ma dang sna tshogs dbang phyug thams cad grwa nang ma'i gtso bo lta bu/ shar sgor rang byung srid rgyal mthing nag khros pa'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi kha ṭ+waṃ phur bu me long sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ ma mo'i chas kyis brgyan pa/ tsan 'khyil gyis dre'u'i steng du bzhugs pa'i phang du/ za byed kyi mgon po ber nag po mi sdug pa'i bzhin can mi'u thung gel ba'i gzugs/ mthing nag g.yas zangs gri 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ thod rus sbrul gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ lho sgor seṅge dkar mo la chibs pa'i jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma sku mdog dkar mo phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ gzugs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa/ lha'i bu mo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho dang ldan zhing dbu skra mthon mthing lhas ma rgyab tu 'phyang zhing cung zad bcings pa'i zur phud yid bzhin gyi nor bus brgyan pa/ snyan gong gser dang ut+pa la'i phreng ba dang rna ltag tu dar gyi cod pan g.yo ba/ nor bu'i rna cha gdub kor dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ dpung rgyan dang*/

phyag zhabs gser gyi gdu bus spras shing*/ mu tig gi do shal dang rin po che'i ska rags can/ dar dkar po yid du 'ong ba'i stod g.yogs dang*/ ka tsa lin+da'i smad g.yogs 'chang ba mtshar sdug 'od du chags pa/ shin tu sgeg cing 'gying ba/ g.yas logs su shān+ta pu rir gnas pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po zla ba'i 'od can glang po che'i dbu mche ba gcig gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum chags pas gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po zur phud lnga bcings pa la yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang zla tshes kyis brgyan pa/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis la phug dang zas kyi gzhong pa/ lhag ma gnyis bgrang phreng dang dgra s+t+wa/ rin po che dang me tog gi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te/ nor bu skyug pa'i byi ba'i khar gel ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ nub sgor rdo rje g.yu'i sgron ma khros ma dmag zor gyi rgyal mo gcer bu mthing nag dbu dgu rak+ṣa si'i gdong pa can/ srid pa gsum shar za ba'i kha mo che dgu gdangs nas mche ba ri ltar du gtsigs pa'i 'gram dang mig nas nad rigs thams cad khrag gi rgyun du 'dzag pa/ lus las me dpung 'phro zhing ltas ngan pa dang*/ cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la gtong ba/ sna rnams nas thal ba'i rlung dmar 'tshub pa/ dbu re re las spyan gsum gsum dgra la gzir nas glog ltar 'khyug pa/ g.yu yi ral pas stong gsum khengs pa/ nu ma 'phyang ba/ bha ga bsgrad pa/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis gri thod/ lhag ma g.yas gsum ral gri dgra s+t+wa lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum rtse gsum zhags pa cang te'u brdung ba/ khrag zhag thal bas byugs pa/ lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la chibs pa/ g.yas su rta nag dregs pa chen po spyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang nag rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher ba/ rtsa ba'i zhal mi bzad par khros pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri reg gcod kyi spu gri'i so can 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon bhañja klad khrag snying gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol ba'i steng du dur khrod kyi chas brgyad tshang bar mnabs pa/

gser gwa sked la bcings nas swag ri'i lahwam dang bcas te stag mo drus ma la chibs pa/ byang sgor dur khrod kyi bdag mo shin tu khros pa keng rus gar byed pa'i gzugs can phyag g.yas dbyug tho 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon bhan dmar khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar gyi sham thabs can rang 'dra ba'i yab g.yas su gnas pa/ gzhan yang gnas gsum dang*/ pho nya dang*/ 'jig rten dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma rje mo bcu bzhi/ srid pa'i sman mo lnga cu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa 'jigs byed ma mo'i tshogs srid tshad sprin ltar du 'khrigs pa/ sku dkyil gyi lha khyams nang ma'i shar gyi g.yas su/ lha'i mgon po gu lang dbang phyug chen po sku mdog dmar po gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ g.yas skye 'gro 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ g.yon srid pa gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i rlung gi zhags pa dang bcas pa'i liṅga bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing ral pa zla tshes kyis spras pa/ 'od dang ldan pa'i rtags gyen du bsgreng zhing phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ g.yon du lha mo u ma 'phrul gyi me long dang bum pa bzung ste yab kyi phyed du bzhugs pa/ 'khor tshangs pa dang*/ 'dod lha dang*/ dbang po dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ nye dbang dang*/ gzhon nu dang*/ bhṛṃ gi ri dang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs te gzugs dang 'dod lha grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyis bskor ba/ g.yon du bdud kyi mgon po seṅge'i gdong pa can sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag cing bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid 'bar ba/ seṅge'i zhal rngam zhing khros pa'i nyams can/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa'i zhal gdangs shing ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ ral pa sngo skya gyen du brdzes pa'i gseb nas seng chung mang po 'phro ba khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i seṅge'i nga ro 'brug ltar du sgrog pa/

phyag g.yas mdung dar nag po srid rtse'i bar du 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa glo snying gi gtor mas gang ba bsnams pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber brtsegs mar gsol ba'i nang mar rin po che'i ska rags dang gser gwa mdzes par bcings pa/ zhabs gnyis drag shul chen po'i stobs kyis gung gnyis la gling bzhi khyab par rgyu ba'i bdud rta nag po rlung gi shugs can la chibs pa/ me'i phung po gcig tu 'bar ba/ g.yon du bdud mo seng gdong ma sku mdog dmar mo rab tu khros pa'i spyan bsgrad cing zhal gdangs pa/ ral pa dmar po 'bar ba'i nang nas khro chung me stag ltar 'phro ba/ dar dmar gyi ber gyon zhing stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ phyag g.yas tri shū la 'debs pa'i tshul du bsnams pa/ g.yon pa mi snying dron mo bar ma chad par gsol ba/ myur mgyogs kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i rta dmar la zhon pa/ yab yum de dag gi g.yas dang g.yon du las mkhan 'jigs byed dus mtshan nag po yab yum kha dog ser ba spre'u'i gdong pa can/ lag gnyis bya sder sa la btsugs nas spyi'u tshugs su 'gro zhing*/ rkang pas thod pa gtor mas gang ba thogs pa/ mi lpags kyis sked dkris shing lus stod kyi thad du rlung nag 'tshub pa/ sked par me dpung mched cing 'bar ba/ rkang pa'i thad sor glog gi phreng ba dang bcas pa'i sprin 'khrigs pa'i cho 'phrul gtong ba/ 'khor du dmag dpon badz+ra sā dhu nag po/ dar dkar gyi ral gu gyon pa/ g.yas lcags kyi tho chen 'bar ba 'phyar nas dgra bgegs kyi mgo bo 'gems zhing*/ g.yon sbud pa nag po drag tu 'bud pas myos par byed pa/ ra skyes kham pa la zhon pa/ gshin rje/ klu/ bdud/ srin po/ srog bdag btsan/ ma mo ste bdud kyi sde dpon chen po brgyad/ pho bdud nyi shu rtsa gcig nag po stong la sogs pa bdud kyi rigs thams cad dang*/ smyo byed la sogs pa 'byung po dang*/ brjed byed la sogs pa gdon dang*/

za byed la sogs pa sha za'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ lho'i g.yas su gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po dmar nag khrag gi rgya mtsho rul ba lta bu/ gcer bu rgyan med rtags bsgreng ba/ ma he khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa ljags bsgril nas ngar sgra 'brug ltar du sgrog pa/ spyan gsum dmar po gzir ba/ sma ra ag tshom smin ma 'bar zhing 'khyil ba/ ral pa gsigs pa'i gseb nas gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad spro ba/ gnam lcags kyi rwa rtses srid pa gsum gyi lto ba 'bigs pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag 'chang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis srin gyi ma he khros pa'i steng du bzhugs shing*/ tsā muṇ+ḍi ma he mo'i gdong can dmar nag tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang rtse ba/ g.yas su srog bdag mon pa dmar po bswe'i zhub can dpa' bo'i ngar skad sgrog cing*/ bse mdung dang mda' gzhu khyer te rta rgod mi zan la zhon pa/ dgra la jag par chas nas srog dbugs me ltar du len pa/ g.yon du skye dgu'i srog gi sgor gza'i zer la zhon nas rgyu ba'i 'chi bdud nag po mda' gzhu khyer ba/ 'khor du gshin rje ya ba ti/ mig dmar/ chos rgyal/ phya sang*/ tel pa/ rmig pa/ a ba/ ral pa tshar dgu ste gshin rje'i sde dpon chen po brgyad/ lo zla zhag za ma'i gshed la sogs pa gshin rje'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ g.yon du srin po'i mgon po khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la lus po gcig la mgo bo dgu yod pa steng phyogs bya rog gi zhal dang bcu/ dbu dgu ni rtsa ba'i zhal gsum gshin rje'i zhal g.yas ljang*/ g.yon nag dbus dud kha 'bar ba/ spyan dgu thur du gzigs pa/ bar gyi zhal gsum bdud kyi zhal g.yas mthing*/ g.yon dmar/ dbus ljang nag spyan dgu bar snang la gzigs pa/ steng gi zhal gsum lha'i zhal g.yas ljang g.yon dmar/ dbus dkar ba/ zhi ba'i spyan dgu steng du gzigs pa/

shin tu rngam pa'i rang bzhin can/ mche ba gtsigs shing smin ma dang sma ra'i bar nas bskal pa'i me stag 'phro ba/ mgo lus thams cad mig gis gang zhing khro ba dang 'khrugs pa dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas na chu srin gyi zhags pa bsnams pas sa bdag gdug pa'i snying nas 'dren zhing thal bar rlog pa/ g.yon rwa'i mda' gzhu bsnams pas dam nyams pa'i dgra bo sgrol ba/ sku smad sbrul du yod pa/ klu rgyal rigs dang*/ rje'u rigs dang*/ dmangs rigs dang*/ bram ze dang*/ gdol pa'i rigs kyis phyag dang rgyan rnams la phra mig tu mdzes pa/ sku mdog dud kha 'jigs pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ sku stod nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs pa/ sku smad rgya mtsho'i gting na 'khyil ba/ snang srid kyi lha 'dre gzhan rnams kyis mthong na 'jigs shing skrag par 'gyur ba/ stag srin zor ba'i gdong pa can ser nag stag lpags gyon pa nyi ma la chibs nas zor ba bsnams pa/ baṃ srin dred mo'i gdong pa can sngo nag dred lpags gyon pa zla ba la chibs nas sbrul zhags bsnams pa/ kong srin ba lang gi gdong pa can dmar nag glang lpags gyon pa sdig pa la chibs nas zangs gri bsnams pa/ 'brog srin chu srin gyi gdong pa can ljang nag chu srin gyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa rmig bu la chibs nas be con bsnams pa/ 'khor ljang sngon drag po/ drang srong dkar ser/ bdud po rog ti/ biṣ+ṭi pa tra/ byi nu rā dza/ du ba mjug ring*/ biṣ+ṇu/ sgra gcan te lha chen brgyad kyis dregs pa las la bkol ba/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams kyis nyams pa byad du stems pa/ lha ma yin gtum po rnams kyis mtshon cha'i char 'bebs pa/ laṅka'i bdag po la sogs pa srin po'i tshogs srog dbugs za ba rnams kyis bskor ba/ nub kyi g.yas su klu'i mgon po nā ga rak+sha nag po sku stod srin po'i gzugs can/ rgyab ri rab la gtad pa/ sku smad rgya mtsho'i gting du 'khyil ba/ rtsa zhal srin po shin tu khros pa/

lhag ma sbrul nag brgyad bar snang la 'phyo ba'i dbus mar rin po che'i prog zhu can/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon brgyad sbrul zhags 'phen pa'i dang po gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba/ zhal nas ika sha ika sha zhes pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ srid pa gsum po lto na chug pa/ yum klu mo khros ma sbal mgo dgu pa/ phyag gnyis sbrul lpags dang nad rkyal bsnams pa/ 'khor stobs kyi rgyu/ dung skyong*/ pad+ma/ nor rgyas/ mtha' yas/ rigs ldan/ 'jog po/ pad chen la sogs pa'i klu/ gnyan chen sde bzhi la sogs pa'i gnyan/ the se la sogs pa'i sa bdag ste lto 'phye'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ g.yon du btsan gyi mgon po beg rtse dmar po zhal bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ rkan sgra rdeb pa/ sdang mig gis bgegs dpung sreg pa/ phyag g.yas zangs gri rnon po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dgra bo'i glo snying mda' gzhu bswe mdung rnams 'dzin pa/ dpa' ba/ zangs kyi ya lad can/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo'i do shal/ swag ri'i lahwam gsol zhing sprul pa'i pho nya 'gyed pa/ g.yon du srin mo gdong dmar ma mi lpags kyi ral gu dang*/ mgo bo'i do shal can zangs gri dang phur bu bsnams pa/ g.yas su las mkhan dmag dpon chen po ce spyang la zhon pa zangs kyi zhub can btsan zhags mda' ltar du 'phen pa/ de'i mtha' skor du gri thogs kyi ging sde brgyad/ srog gcod kyi bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa btsan gyi rigs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ byang gi g.yas su gnod sbyin gyi mgon po zhang 'on nag po khrag ral can/ thung zhing sbom la gsus khyim che ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum 'bur tshugs su lta ba/ dbu la rin po che'i prog zhu 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas dgos 'dod stsol ba'i nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon nad thams cad sel ba'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/

brjid cing rab tu brjid pa'i sku la dar nag gi ber chen sum brtsegs gsol ba'i 'og ma la ska rags gser gwa rin chen 'bar ba bcings pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ swag lahwam rin po che'i 'bur can gyon pa'i zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis srin po pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ g.yon du sring mo gnod sbyin nag mo dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa'i kha nas khrag dang dug chu 'bab pa/ phyag g.yas nad kyi rkyal pa dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i gzhong pa zhal zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba yab la stob pa/ 'khor gang ba bzang po/ nor bu bzang po/ yang dag shes/ ku be ra/ 'brog gnas/ lngas rtsen/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li/ dzam+bha la ste gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad/ nag po 'bar ba la sogs pa lcags khrab can drag po'i las sgrub pa/ gtum po nyi ma'i gzi brjid la sogs pa gser khrab can rgyas pa'i las sgrub pa/ ha la 'bar byed la sogs pa smug po bswe khrab can dbang gi las sgrub pa/ 'brog gnas mched lnga la sogs pa g.yu'i khrab can zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i gnod sbyin gtum po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ g.yon du ging gi mgon po mthing nag rngam zhing khros pa/ za 'og gi 'jol ber dang dom gyi slag pa gyon pa/ dar nag gi thibs zhu can/ g.yas spu gri 'phyar zhing g.yon bdud zhags 'dzin pa/ ba glang sna ring la zhon pa/ yum shān+ti ro zan ma dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ ral gri 'phyar zhing ne'u le dkur brten pa dang rtse ba/ nang blon pu tra nag po ral gri dang thod pa can dar gyi ang ga rag dang dar nag gi gos can/ bha tra nag po stag slag can dam shing dang mi snying bzung ba/ sring mo gser gyi spu gri dang rgyu ma 'dzin pa/ gsum ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal can/ rtsi ma ra bswe'i khrab rmog bgos shing mdung dmar dang zhags pa bzung nas rta rgod bra bo g.yu rngon la zhon pa/

g.yas kyi ru 'dren skyes pa stag chas can brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren dge slong brgya/ slad kyi rjes 'brang sngags pa nag po brgya/ mdun gyi shul 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya/ gar mkhan skyo bsangs 'bag la sogs pa skyes bu ging gi tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ lha khyams phyi'i phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu/ brgya byin dkar po rdo rje 'chang ba/ me lha dmar po bgrang phreng 'chang ba/ gshin rje nag po be con 'chang ba/ srin po nag po ral gri 'chang ba/ chu bdag dkar po sbrul zhags 'chang ba/ rlung lha nag po ba dan 'chang ba/ gnod sbyin ser po dbyug tho 'chang ba/ dbang ldan dkar po rtse gsum 'chang ba/ gdong bzhi ser po 'khor lo 'chang ba/ sa 'dzin ser po bum pa 'chang ba dang*/ shar sgor rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dkar po bai ḍūr+ya'i rgyud mangs sbreng ba/ lho sgor rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'chang ba/ nub sgor rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten bsnams pa/ byang sgor rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser po g.yas rgyal mtshan dang g.yon ne'u le bzung nas seṅge'i steng na bzhugs pa bzhi ka'ang gzi brjid tshad med pa/ lha'i go khrab dang rgyan gyis legs par brgyan pa/ phyogs bcu'i mgon po 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi ka'ang btsun mo nang mi snag gi gnyen mngag gzhug rang rang gi sde dpung thams cad kyis bskor ba/ ro langs brgya phyogs mtshams thams cad du rgyu ba/ sprul pa'i dregs pa bco brgyad las la rgyug pa/ sde dpon sum cu bka' la nyan pa/ phyi nang gsang ba sbas pa sngags bstan pa skyong ba/ las byed rtags chags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad thams cad lus mi sdug pa'i gzugs bred dgur tshogs pa/ ngag mi snyan pa'i sgras 'khol ba/ yid snying rje med par gtum pas srid pa gsum po za bar chas pa/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gtso bo'i hū?ṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa lha mo bzhi la phog pas/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du spros/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi ma hā kā la lcam dral/ rdo rje'i pho nya mo dang pho nya/ bka' sdod kyi mgon po lha ma srin dregs pa sde brgyad/ phyogs dang 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad sgrol ba'i las la myur ba sha stag gi tshogs kyis mdun du bdar ba/ ltas chen po bco brgyad dang bcas pas/ phyogs mtshams thams cad du mi zad pa'i gnam rdo ltung bzhin par mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i klong*// pha mtha' gdal ba yum gyi mkha'// ma lus rgyal ba bgrod pa'i yul// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa nas// ye shes mgon po spyan 'dren gyis// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das rnams kyi// rang bzhin 'jigs byed he ru kar// mngon par bzhengs nas gshegs su gsol// khams gsum yongs las cher 'phags pa'i// 'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' ba// phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan gyi yul// kun bzang 'byor pa rgyas pa nas// dam tshig mgon po spyan 'dren gyis// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor cher// gcig pu sna tshogs lhar 'char ba// chu zla'i gar gyis gshegs su gsol// stong gsum chen po'i 'jig rten dbus// rdo rje gdan gyi dzam bu'i drung*// dpa' bo sangs rgyas brnyes pa'i yul// chos kyi g.ye yi dgon pa nas// sprul pa'i mgon po spyan 'dren gyis// sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs bdag /dam pa chos kyi srog shing che// bya rog ming can gshegs su gsol// nā len+d+ra dang rnam gnon tshal// shrī dha n+ya ka ṭa ka

/pad+ma ge sar rgyas pa'i yul// chos kyi 'byung gnas chen po nas// bka' srung mgon po rnams 'bod kyis// bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs 'joms shing*// dkar po skyong ba dgra lha'i rgyal// legs ldan thams cad gshegs su gsol// bya rgod phung po'i ri bo'i 'dabs// 'jigs su rung ba bsil ba'i tshal// dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi'i yul// laṅka gdong dmar rgya nag nas// rdo rje pho nya rnams 'bod kyis// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi// mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba che// zhing skyong thams cad gshegs su gsol// hūm̐/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas lha chen po// mun pa'i klong nas bdud kyi mgon// sa 'og dgu nas chos kyi rgyal// bar snang khams nas gdug pa gza'// rgya mtsho'i byings nas klu yi srin// mya ngan med nas beg rtse can// ri rab rtse nas zhang 'on dang*// chos 'khor rnams nas li byin har// phyogs mtshams rnams nas skyong ba bcu// bang rim ngos nas rgyal chen bzhi// 'jig rten mgon po ma lus pa// btsun mo nang mi snag gi gnyen// mngag gzhug dmag gi sder bcas pa// bdag gi dad pas spyan 'dren gyis// mthu stobs chen pos gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la su tri ya ma du dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs/ bzhugs su gsol ba/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni// bka' sdod mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// srid pa ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas// 'dir bshams 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs// thun mong khyad par bla na med// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni// dngos dang yid las byung ba dag /nam mkha' mnyam pa snyed kyis mchod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las gtso bo la bde mchog dang*/ gzhan rnams la rdo rje srin po ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces rdo rje spyi bor bzhag dam chu ljags la byin/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bstan pa srung zhing bka' la gnas// dam tshig 'dzin pa'i nag po che// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ mchod rdzas thams cad/ oṃ sbyangs/ āḥs spel/ hūm̐ sbar bas/ shar du zhi ba kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin/ lhor rgyas pa nam mkha'i mdzod/ nub tu dbang khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ byang du drag po gshin rje'i khab kyi 'byor pa thams cad par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke=

gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra rak+ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsu ra te s+t+waṃ/ rgyas par sngags kyi sngon du phrin las bzhin du byed la/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dag pa rab 'byams kyi mdangs/ nam mkha'i snod chen por phyi nang gsang bar 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi khar/ bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs dang dgra bo thams cad bsgral ba'i sha'i khor yug chen pos bskor ba/ khrag zhag klad pa'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa/ rus pa sna tshogs pa'i ri bo/ lha ba dang dwangs ma'i rol pa'i chu gter chen pos dkrigs pa/ snying dang*/ glo ba dang*/ mchin pa dang*/ mtsher pa dang*/ mkhal ma dang*/ rgyu ma dang*/ nang khrol gzhan dang*/ mgo lag dang*/ mig la sogs pa dbang po thams cad spungs pa'i lhun po/ mthong na bred pa'i gzugs thams cad par 'char ba/ mi sdug pa'i sgra thams cad kyis khol ba/ baṃ zhing myags pa/ rul zhing sums pa la sogs pa'i dri nga ba thams cad 'tshub pa/ phyogs bcu'i baṃ pho mo thams cad sing nga ro len ma rnams kyis der 'dor ba/ pags pa khrag gis sbags pa thams cad g.yab mo dang bcas te reg byar 'thibs pa/ gzhan yang 'jig rten gsum gyi bza' ba dang btung ba dang bca' ba dang myang ba dang bldag pa dang gzhib pa'i zas kyi gnas thams cad snang ba/ yongs 'du dang 'dzam bu dang dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pa'i 'bras bu/ ma rmos pa la sogs pa'i 'bru/ bi dza pū ra la sogs pa'i sman/ 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i bcud thams cad chags pa/ dbang du byed pa'i la du/ nyams pa'i srog dbugs bla tshe kha rje dbang thang klung rta la sogs pa/ khyim gyi 'khor lo sgang gshong du 'khor ba/ rmang srid pa'i gting du bcas pa/ mtho dgung sngon gyi dbyings su slebs pa/ rgya nam mkha'i mtha' tshun chad du brdal ba/

dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nas 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'i bar gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam can rgya mtsho thams cad hab hab rgyug cing dungs dungs 'khrungs nas rngam rngam por rkan sgra tog bzhin pas dur khrod kyi ro la bya rgod kyis rub pa lta bur thugs kyi re kha ma rdzogs kyi bar du gsol bar gyur/ thugs dkyil gyi mgon po rnams la/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi e ṣa a paṣatsi ma kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tīdz+nya sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ satwa na/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭ hūm̐/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor rnams la/ oṃ ka ka ka dh+ya na/ ba ba ban+dha na/ kha kha kha da na/ sarba duṣ+ṭan/ ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya a mu ka s+ya/ shīn+taṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ dzaḥswā hā/ sku dkyil rnams la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twat+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ ces lan gsum gyis 'bul/ rgyas par spro na rang rang gi srog gam ming sngags kyi mthar i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pas 'bul/ de nas/ dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad sgrol ba'i dpa' bo/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa skyong ba/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha chen po/ legs ldan rdo rje srin po bya rog gi ming can/ yum chen pe tā li/ e ka dzā ṭi/ dud pa'i sol ba ma/ re ma ti mched bzhi/ hūm̐ mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po/ myur mdzad dam tshig gi mgon po/ gsang ba'i mgon po/ 'jigs byed kyi mgon po/ las mkhan chen po/ gsod byed kyi mgon po/ rngam byed kyi mgon po/ sgrol byed kyi mgon po/ ye shes kyi ma gsum/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka 'bar ba'i gdong*/

las kyi ma mo gsum/ sku'i mgon po stag zhon yab yum/ gsung gi mgon po a gho ra yab yum/ thugs kyi mgon po nag po chen po 'bar ba yab yum/ yon tan gyi mgon po legs ldan yab yum/ phrin las kyi mgon po gri gug yab yum/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi mgon po beng yab yum/ rbod gtong gi mgon po ma ning yab yum/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i mgon po traka shad yab yum ste mgon po bka' brgyad/ sgo mtshams skyong ba'i lha mo brgyad/ rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi/ zhing skyong chen po so gnyis/ srid pa'i rgyal mo dang ber nag can/ bkra shis tshe ring ma dang tshogs kyi bdag po/ ral gcig g.yu sgron ma dang rta nag dregs pa chen po/ dur khrod bdag mo yab dang bcas pa/ lha'i mgon po gu lang dbang phyug chen po/ bdud kyi mgon po nag po seṅge'i gdong*/ gshin rje'i mgon po dam can chos kyi rgyal po/ srin po'i mgon po gza' bdud dug gi spu gri/ lto 'phye'i mgon po klu bdud nā ga rak+sha/ btsan gyi mgon po sgrol ging chen po beg rtse/ gnod sbyin gyi mgon po zhang 'on nag po khrag ral can/ ging gi mgon po rgyal po chen po pe ha ra/ phyogs bcu'i mgon po/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ btsun mo nang mi snag gi gnyen mngag gzhug dmag gi sde dang bcas pa dam pa chos byed pa'i bka' sdod thams cad la mchod sbyin chen po 'di 'bul lo// spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par du dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzod cig sgos rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sngon gyi las 'phral gyi rkyen ngan pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ phas kyi sngags bon mu stegs nag pos phyag rgya sngags ting nge 'dzin ci dang cis byad du stems pa/

sa la mnan pa/ chu la gtad pa/ me la bsreg pa/ rlung la bskor ba la sogs pa thams cad byed pa po rang la gshed du phob cig snang srid kyi lha 'dres za ba'i kha gtad pa/ gnod pa'i dbal 'dzugs pa/ mtho'i rgyan gzhi gtings pa/ shwa'i rde'u spungs pa/ byad kyi khram la 'debs pa thams cad dgra la sgyur cig zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dgug pa dang*/ drag po'i las thams cad la dbang dang ldan pa/ grub pa brgyad dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dngos grub kyi mchog sbyin par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bstod pa rkang brgyad dang til mar ma'i rjes la/ thugs dkyil ba la/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs thugs rjes sku sprul pa// sems can rnams la mgon skyabs mdzad// 'og min gnas na bzhugs pa la// rab tu btud de gus phyag 'tshal/ gsung dkyil ba la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi skur bstan pa// 'dren pa 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gtso// drag po ma rungs 'dul mdzad pa// ma hā kā lir phyag 'tshal bstod// sku dkyil ba rnams la/ 'jig rten la gnas gdug pa 'dul// dur khrod ma mo rnams kyi gtso// lha chen drag po'i skur ston pa'i// 'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas sam/ rgyas par phrin las kyi gzhung bzhin du gyer zhing*/ 'dzab byang bzhin du bzlas pa byas nas/ mdor bsdus pas slar mchod cing bstod de/ rten yod na dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par de la bstim/ med na ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa badz+ra muḥ sa thams cad rang la bstim/ dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs kyis bsngo// bkra shis brjod/ 1$0000250tshig gi spun pas ma rnyogs shing*// don min lhad kyis ma bslad pa// myangs na zhim pa'i chos kyi ro// sus 'thung kha de lha yi zhal// gang zhig rgyud lung rgya mtsho che// bsrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ma mthong bar// phyogs re'i chang bum la 'thungs pa'i// myos spyod bzang por phal cher rlom// chos kyi rgyal po rnam rgyal lha'i// rgyal mkhar rtser 'os 'di shes nas// pad dkar rnam dpyod mtha' yas kyis// ngal bas ston 'di dar gyur cig
/gdags phu zhes bya'i shug gseb tu// bla ma'i lung gi rjes 'brangs nas// gzhan gyis ma rnyed 'di rgyud bzhin// rnyed pa ngo mtshar dag gi gter// dge legs 'phel/// /
